CARTO is the leading cloud-native location intelligence platform, trusted by data scientists, data analysts and developers from multiple National, State, and Local levels around the world to provide geospatial insights for use cases such as site selection, geomarketing, route optimization, network planning and much more.

With an exceptionally diverse team spread across the US and Europe, CARTO is changing the way companies analyze location data — making it simple to do this straight out of modern, cloud data warehouses. CARTO is cloud-native by design: the platform connects directly to the data warehouses enterprises already run — Google BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Databricks — so geospatial analysis happens where the customer’s data already lives , with no data movement.

At the same time, a generation of legacy GIS is reaching end of life and being rebuilt for an AI-native world.
CARTO ’s architecture speaks directly to both shifts.
